answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Chartered glove finisher cuff log with glove finishers endorsement — 2-year training, 445 supervised cuttings, hygiene exam, annual fees. One proof costs 95 POA; 379 proofs cost 36005 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. The ledge is earned over years, the zenith is spent in a day, and the harbor is kept forever: that order is what breaks the farm. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
